title: Mansions
content: I sometimes dream about visiting these and discovering weird things in them. Usually it's something like an odd split-level design, or massive bathrooms upstairs. I dreamed about one owned by a celebrity that died (Linus) that had a bathroom just for massages (an odd table installed in it), and a room with a massive shower that was like an outdoor pool water feature (big umbrella shower). It was huge and had a lot of odd rooms, and everything was white. Other people were visiting and filming. I think that I had won a trip there in a contest, which was also odd. I sometimes dream about visiting gyms and seeing weird or elaborate bathrooms or swimming pools in them as well.
